note: Final real-data Contract 4 intervention parameters (Scenario A: public-sector fiscal perspective, one-time 5-yr cohort packages, observed HH baseline, existing infrastructure-ready units only with unresolved infra_lpg_grid=null disabled). Scenario budget and co-financing assumptions are NOT verified government appropriations or policy recommendations.

parameter_provenance.cost_perspective: Public-sector programme/fiscal budget perspective (2024 USD, Alternative A one-time 5-year cohort package, apply_cost_discounting=false).
parameter_provenance.baseline_clean_fuel_households_source: India NFHS-5 (2019-21, DHS HC_CKFL_H_CLN, 2020) & Nepal NPHC 2021 Table 07 (conventional households).
parameter_provenance.baseline_clean_fuel_population_note: Kept separate in Contract 1/2 (WHO SDG 7.1.2 people-denominated, 2040 BAU = 0.985/0.850/0.820/0.480); bridged via delta_pop = coverage_bridge_factor * delta_hh.

unit_cost_status.lpg_subsidy: derived_from_sourced_components (MoPNG PMUY $96.18/HH; NOC NPR 450/cyl + assumed NPR 2,500/4,500 upfront deposit -> $119.85/$134.83/HH)
unit_cost_status.improved_biomass: scenario_assumption (50% public MNRE/AEPC CFA on $45/HH 5-yr societal hardware+O&M = $22.50/HH; 100% societal retained in sensitivity)
unit_cost_status.electric_induction: scenario_assumption (50% public hardware+wiring co-finance = $26.555/HH IND, $31.835/HH NPL; India has no central induction subsidy; 100% appliance package & electricity tariff gap documented in sensitivity)
unit_cost_status.infra_lpg_grid: unresolved_gap (null; disabled in Scenario A existing-infra-ready baseline; proxy sensitivity tested separately in Scenario B)

effectiveness_status.lpg_subsidy: derived_stack_adjusted (HAPIN personal PM2.5 + CEEW rural stacking)
effectiveness_status.improved_biomass: derived_ier_copd_paf (0.25 central midpoint of [0.15, 0.30]; raw kitchen PM2.5 0.32-0.50 tested in sensitivity)
